title: hk reads truncated process command lines on Linux when COLUMNS is set
description: procps ps on Linux truncates the command column to $COLUMNS (80 by default when piped with COLUMNS set) unless -ww is passed. hk.runtime._process_table and plan.py's kill revalidation call ps without -ww, so a long command line (an interpreter under /opt/hostedtoolcache, a deep project path) is cut: dev servers go undetected, and NEVER_KILL globs are matched against a truncated string. Found by HS-14's first CI run: test_orphaned_dev_server_in_repo_is_found_and_stopped failed on ubuntu-latest (Python 3.9 and 3.12) and passes on macOS, whose ps does not truncate piped output. Reproduced in python:3.12-slim with COLUMNS=80.

acceptanceCriteria.text: every ps invocation in scripts/hk passes -ww
a regression test sets COLUMNS=80 and asserts a long command line reaches _process_table in full
the regression test fails on Linux against the pre-fix engine and passes with the fix, shown in a Linux container
